Dialogs.Dialog: Listen, there's someone I like now.
...Oh! Come on, you mean a musician.
Wait... Then a character from a novel？ Or a game character or something？
(▲小早川＊▲... What was that about earlier？)
What did you mean back there？
You really have no idea？ Sigh... I'm worried about you.
What's that supposed to mean？ I'm the one who's worried here.
...Sorry. I didn't think you'd take it so seriously.
(▲小早川＊▲... No good, it's bothering me too much to do anything.)
Calm down first. Close your eyes.
I'm really sorry. I just never thought...
I figured I'd say, 'There's someone I like,' and you'd go, 'Come on, it's April Fools'!' ...or something.
Pretty much. But I don't dislike that about you. Sorry, hope this makes up for it.
Oh right, Golden Week. What about it？
Well, not all of Golden Week, just the three days from the 3rd to the 5th.
They say if you share a long kiss every day during those three days, you'll suddenly get a lot closer.
You know the one I mean.
(She must mean the one that goes on forever...)
Idiot, don't take it so seriously.
(Then why'd she even bring it up？)
The Golden Week kiss. Don't you remember？
Not that I think something like this changes anything.
(Still, I feel like I got closer to ▲小早川＊▲...)
I don't really care that you didn't, so it's fine.
The Golden Week kiss. I knew you forgot.
I told you, I don't care.
(The pool opens today. It's a joint class with ▲小早川＊▲'s grade, so...)
What does that even mean？ Just say it straight.
Out of everyone here, you're the cutest, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Getting compared to others doesn't make me happy, you know.
(I'm looking forward to pool classes from now on!)
(The pool opens today. It's a joint class with ▲小早川＊▲'s grade, so...)
I wasn't! ...Well, I wasn't staring. Probably.
Come any closer and I'll kick you.
And if you stare at other girls, I'll report you for sexual harassment.
Is getting kicked the better option here？
(I'm looking forward to pool classes from now on!)
(The pool opens today. It's a joint class with ▲小早川＊▲'s grade, so...)
Hehe. Being at the school pool like this feels kind of fresh, huh？
Don't stare so much. Everyone's around.
(I'm looking forward to pool classes from now on!)
If you're free, come keep me company.
Sure, doing what？ Want me to time your laps？
No way, too much work. Reading. Very library committee of me, right？
Everyone's just messing around in the pool anyway. So I can do whatever, right？
(Pretty sure that's not how it works...)
Hey, how long can you hold your breath underwater？
Hmm... I don't know. Maybe a minute or so？
Then try for three minutes. If you make it, you can have my chips in the library.
What, three times as long！？ And that reward is tiny!
No complaining! Come on, get in there.
I really do look kind of childish, don't I？
Huh？ Why do you ask that？
Well, with everyone in the same swimsuit... you know, how I look and all.
Really？ I wasn't looking at anyone besides you, ▲小早川＊▲, so I couldn't tell.
Heh, quit trying to sound so cool.
I thought pool class would be a pain, but I kinda like it. It's almost all free time.
I've rested plenty, so maybe I'll actually swim for once.
As if. Come on, let's go.
Sorry. Didn't think I'd startle you that badly.
I almost stopped breathing. ...So come on, give me mouth-to-mouth.
Idiot! Obviously I'm kidding. Stupid, stupid!
(Guess I really caught her off guard...)
...You did. Now I'm gonna tickle you to get even.
Whoa, hey! Don't yell stuff like that out loud!
Oh yeah, now that you mention it.
I guess families with little kids decorate bamboo grass and make wishes, huh.
Probably... I bet a lot of families do that, right？
Oh, right. You've got a little brother at home, too.
Hey, about Tanabata earlier. What are you torn about？
I mean... Me, writing wishes on paper strips？ Doesn't really suit me, does it？
You think？ You actually kind of like that stuff, don't you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I take issue with how you put that... Look, I have my own lines to draw.
Huh. So you're debating whether to play along for your brother's sake.
Right. It's a clash between sentiment and attitude.
I don't really get it. What do you mean？
Well... Personal principles are hard to explain!
Hey, about Tanabata. I decided to do it after all.
I see. Hope he likes it.
You really act like the grown-up around your little brother, ▲小早川＊▲.
I'm always plenty grown-up, aren't I？ I even have a boyfriend and everything.
Guess that's partly thanks to ●, then.
Don't let it go to your head. Still, maybe so. I appreciate it, so...thanks.
(It's over... Coming to school just for this, school days are a pain...)
▲小早川＊▲. You don't have to just run off like that. We finally got to hang out.
It's not like we can't see each other whenever.
Good grief, having a needy boyfriend is such work...
(It's over... Coming to school just for this, school days are a pain...)
Then what's the problem？ At least help me kill some time.
(It's over... Coming to school just for this, school days are a pain...)
Just felt like coming by. That's fine once in a while, right？
...is what you were just thinking. Am I wrong？
'Cause I was thinking the exact same thing.
Don't look so gloomy. You're bringing me down too.
Ah, my bad. Still, you don't wanna be here either, right？
Obviously. Complaining won't change anything, so drop it.
Hey, wanna go to the arcade？
Well, that came out of nowhere.
You did put in a lot of practice, after all.
Sounds like a pain, but why not go for a win while you're at it？ I'll be watching.
So, I really don't want to, but I got roped into doing the three-legged race.
Haha, I see. Well, just accept your fate and do your best.
No, that's not it. I have to find a partner, too.
Oh, that's what you mean. Alright, wanna team up then？
Of course. Come on, let's get a quick practice in.
Hm？ What was that？ Come on, let's go.
Nothing! ...Geez, look at you getting all fired up.
Sigh, dead last... Do we just have bad chemistry？
I think we were in sync. It was more of a stamina issue.
Mine, you mean. Even though you were trying so hard.
Don't worry about it. It still made for a good memory.
If it's with you, ▲小早川＊▲, even that's not so bad.
What's that supposed to mean？ Are you a masochist？
How do you get that from what I said？!
Just kidding. Thanks. I was really glad you helped me...
Hey, are you doing anything for Halloween？
Oh right, that's today. I don't really have any plans.
Right？ Dressing up and all that is kind of a hassle.
Maybe so... Though if we actually did it, it might be fun.
Why？ Do you have plans or something, ▲小早川＊▲？
Not really... Wonder what I should do.
(There's nothing on TV I want to watch. What should I do...)
▲小早川＊▲？ What are you doing here all of a sudden？
What, am I not allowed to come over？
That's not what I meant. Anyway, come on in.
So, what's up？ Was there something going on today？
Sort of. I'm gonna go get ready. Don't come over here.
Um, how did it go again？ Give me candy, or you get a light kick!
Something instead of candy would be fine too, though...
Hehe, I surprised you, didn't I？
Well, yeah... So this is what you were thinking about when Halloween came up.
Yeah. I actually had a lot of fun. How about you？
● wouldn't say it was fun, exactly...
More like embarrassing... or it had my heart racing...
Is that seriously all you've got to say...？
I barged in on you and even made you walk me home. Sorry about that.
Don't worry about it. See you later.
(I worked hard on the steering committee. I hope it's a success...)
(Maybe I'll go check out ▲小早川＊▲'s class...)
...Hey. What's your class doing for the festival？
An exhibit on Towano City's historical records.
Who cares？ It's easy. You're on the steering committee, right？ Keeping busy？
On the actual day, ● don't have that much work.
By the way, what's with that outfit？
I skipped all the prep, so I got stuck luring people into a dull exhibit. The worst...
(Poor thing... Though she did bring it on herself.)
(I'm glad the school festival ended without any issues. Now it's just the party.)
▲小早川＊▲. You changed your clothes, huh.
Well, obviously. Just forget you ever saw that.
Still, the festival itself was a big hit, right？ Thanks to you guys.
Not sure how much ● had to do with it, but I'm glad it went well.
Right. Hey, come with me for a minute.
There's somewhere I want you to go with me real quick.
Nobody's here. This roof's a really nice spot, but nobody ever seems to come up here.
Yeah. That's why... I asked you to meet me here back then, too.
I like it up here, and no one bothers you. That's why I... told you I liked you here.
Now I think of it every time I come up here. I can't just relax anymore. What a pain.
Haha. Wait, did ● do something wrong？
Whatever, that doesn't matter. Besides... I'm thinking about it right now.
Can I do the same thing as back then？
Yeah. Summer classes start today, huh. *Sigh*...
You say that like it's not your problem too.
Hey, what would it take to get summer classes canceled？ Maybe you could go smash all the school windows right now？
Forget summer classes, ● wouldn't have a school life anymore.
Morning. Sure hope summer classes end soon!
Yeah. I'm already sick of summer classes.
Already？ Pretty sure you hated them from the start.
It's hot. Why do they go out of their way to hold summer classes when it's this hot？
Morning. I'm bored of summer classes. Wanna skip？
I know how you feel, but just tough it out.
Yeah. Did you know？ Apparently winter classes start today.
？ Yeah. Isn't that why we're here？
Aw, so this really is reality...
Do I look like I want to take winter classes to you？
Then you should've done something about them before today. It's so unreasonable...
Morning. True or false: winter classes start today.
Yeah. Hey, doesn't getting up in the freezing cold count as passing already？
Yeah. Never mind, I was just saying.
I think I caught a cold.
Huh？ Are you okay to be here？
...Sorry, I lied. I wish Mom had fallen for it too.
Don't say that when you know I can't.
Yeah. Spring classes start today. Wonder how many times I'll doze off...
So dozing off is already a given, huh.
All right, spring classes. I'm gonna try hard today!
Morning. Spring classes start today. Think they'll be over by tomorrow？
I don't think they're quite that short.
I know. I checked plenty of times.
Yeah. I'm definitely staying awake in class today.
I told myself that last time too, though.
Morning. Classes are almost over, huh.
Yeah, I guess so. Gonna miss them？
By the way, ▲小早川＊▲, hear about the contest？
It's got nothing to do with me, anyway.
They might actually pick you, ▲小早川＊▲.
The swimsuit contest. Heard you took first, ▲小早川＊▲.
Guess you're not... too thrilled, huh.
I hate feeling like I'm on display.
Doesn't it bother you？ With your girlfriend, I mean.
I have mixed feelings... but hey, I get to brag about my girlfriend more.
